The note, dated September 6, 2026, compares four wills preserved by Diogenes Laertius
The note’s scope statement specifies a limited set of operations: counting, locating passages, recording co-occurrences, and comparing verbatim clauses.
compares four wills preserved by Diogenes Laertius, two catalogues of philosophical works, Strabo’s account of the books’ transmission, Plutarch’s account of Andronicus of Rhodes
